column1: # ocr-filler-routes.tsv — the GPU OCR routes scripts/gpu/ocr-filler.sh may queue on gex45 (#6871). Tab-separated.
# A route is listed here only when (1) its reader passed a gate (a row in scripts/lib/ocr-routing-table.json or the
# lane decision tree), (2) a writer applies its reads with guards + provenance, and (3) its pages are planned in a lane dir.
# Order = rank: the filler queues the first enabled route with pages left. Disable a route with `-` in the first column.
# Columns: on  route  kind  issue  lane_dir  hold  deadline_h  downstream
#   kind paddle-zh: the Siku Quanshu Paddle lane (#5600). Task = scripts/gpu/paddle-zh-queue-task.sh (read, then
#   `paddle-zh-lane.mjs apply --apply`: revisions, human-edit guard, loop guards, Kanripo WYG screen, hold kept).
#   Pages left = planned pages with no out/<bid>/<pn>.txt|.err.
#   kind gpu-print: the 1800+ English print lane (#6871, LightOnOCR-3-1B). Task = plan the next frame books when the
#   manifest runs low, scripts/gpu/gpu-print-gpu.sh (read), then `gpu-print-lane.mjs apply --apply` (pages with no
#   text only; loop, blank, other-script and commentary guards; revisions; the scans-only hold kept).
#   Pages left = manifest pages with no out/<bid>/<pn>.json|.err + the owed pages of frame books not yet planned.
# Routes considered and NOT listed (2026-10-28, job gpu-ocr-filler-6871):
#   chinese-print (Paddle split-leaf, #6101)   frame read and applied (73,330 pp); census 2026-10-26 found 0 books left.
#                                              Next frame = the Berlin import (422 bk, no page records, license unknown).
#   tibetan (Yigdzin, #4523)                   sets A/B00/B01 (50,794 pp) read by job tib-gemini-ocr-6871, done 10-28 06:47Z;
#                                              the apply (#4523 write rule) is pending on main, not GPU work.
#   european print arm c (#7567)               adopted 10-28, but E3 (guards) + E5 run now (job euro-gpu-e3e5-7567) and no
#                                              production draft→agy runner exists yet. Add it here when one does.
#   gpu-backlog-5660 Siku residue              22K pp scattered ~6 per book, no stored read: the textless pages the lane
#                                              does not store. Re-reading them would mostly re-find blanks.
#   Siku duplicates (no hold, 1,044 bk)        skipped on purpose by job paddle-skqs-rest-6388 (a read copy is live).
